spans.s: हृष् vi. 1P, 4P (pp. हृष्ट or हृषित; pres. हर्षति, हर्षयति) 1. To rejoice, to exult, to be pleased, तौ चाप्यहृषतां ततः Bt.xvii.164; 2. to stand erect (as the hair of the body), e.g. रोमाणि मेऽहृष्यन्; 3. to become erect, (said of other things also).With प्र-, 1. to be glad, to rejoice, न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य Bg.v.19, xvii.36; 2. to stand erect (as the hair of the body).With सम्-, to be glad, to rejoice.
हृषित a. (f. ता) 1. Pleased, delighted, enraptured; 2. having the hair bristling; 3. astonished; 4. bent, bowed, (pp. of हृष् q.v.).
हृषित a. (f. ता) 1. Pleased, delighted, enraptured; 2. having the hair bristling; 3. astonished; 4. bent, bowed, (pp. of हृष् q.v.).
हृषीक n. An organ of sense.
हृषीक-ईश m. an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa, Bg.i.15, 21, 24.
हृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) The same as हृषित q.v.
हृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) The same as हृषित q.v.
हृष्ट-चित्त, -मानस a. rejoiced in mind, happy.
हृष्ट-चित्त, -मानस a. rejoiced in mind, happy.
हृष्ट-रोमन् a. having the hair of the body bristling.
हृष्ट-वदन a. having a cheerful countenance.
हृष्टि f. 1. Delight, joy, happiness; 2. pride.
